encounter.window_rule: Static at admit only: ADMIT_TYPE_CD, ADMIT_SRC_CD, UNIT_CD, FACILITY_CD. Never use DISCH_DT_TM or DISCH_DISPOSITION_CD as features.

person.window_rule: Demographics known at admit; age computed vs REG_DT_TM.

diagnosis.window_rule: Include rows where DIAGNOSIS_DT_TM <= REG_DT_TM + prediction_hour.

clinical_event.window_rule: EVENT_END_DT_TM <= REG_DT_TM + prediction_hour. Pivot vitals/labs to mean_*_0_to_t.

duckdb_patient_features.window_rule: BLOCK entire table for modeling unless rebuilt with censor at T. All columns in FULL_STAY_AGGREGATE_FORBIDDEN.
